properties.description: Pipeline to create template to load Common STG - RAW data without dataflow.

activities.name: Check File Exists
activities.description: Checking if the Stage file is available before progressing to the next activity.

activities.name: Set_File_Exists_status
activities.description: Compare the results of the GetMetadata against the file present in the Stage location

activities.name: Run copy if File Exists
activities.description: Execute if a valid stage file is present

ifTrueActivities.name: cp_STG_to_RAW
ifTrueActivities.description: Copy the Stage file into the RAW container at the same folder hierarchy but with additional timestamps

ifTrueActivities.name: Cleanup_stage
ifTrueActivities.description: Cleanup Stage container of the stage file. So a fresh file is loaded next time

activities.name: lk_get_pipeline_parameters
activities.description:
Lookup the parameters required for this pipeline:
file_name
folder_path

activities.name: Set filename
activities.description: Set the variable v_filename either from the lookupoutput or direct string assignment.

activities.name: Set folderpath
activities.description: Set the variable v_folderpath either from the lookupoutput or direct string assignment.

activities.name: Check Combined File non zero Bytes
activities.description: Check if the combined file has any data to be loaded.

activities.name: Set start date
activities.description: Set the last stage run date to the variable as start date.

activities.name: cp_Get_Latest_File
activities.description: Copy all the files created since the last start date and combine them into one file to be processed into Synapse.

dependsOn.activity: Check Combined File non zero Bytes

ifTrueActivities.name: Delete Temp combined File
ifTrueActivities.description: After the data has been loaded, clear the combined latest file from the ADLSV2
